notes: Both visuals are original KYP redraws. The PCR cycle preserves the source's step order and wording (heated → cooled → temperature increased → Repeat) — note the source figure carries NO temperature numbers, and the KYP redraw deliberately preserves that. The CRISPR visual preserves the source's component labels (Cas9, gRNA, NHEJ, HDR, Donor DNA) and both outcome captions (Frameshift/inactivation 'knock-out'; Edited sequence 'knock-in').
